observations: Photo 0 shows a black and gold graphics card with a single fan, PCIe connector, and multiple output ports. Text overlay identifies it as 'Nvidia RTX A5000 24GB GPU Ampere GDDR6 PCI-E 4.0 Deep learning AI Graphics Card'.

Photo 1 shows the NVIDIA Control Panel with 'System Information' open. The graphics card is listed as 'NVIDIA RTX A5000'. Details include: Driver version 596.86, CUDA cores 8192, Memory clock 16.00 Gbps, Memory interface 384-bit, Memory bandwidth 768.10 GB/s.

Photo 2 is a continuation of the same NVIDIA Control Panel window, showing additional details: Resizable BAR 'No', Graphics boost clock 1695 MHz, Total available graphics memory 57257 MB (which is ~55.9 GB, inconsistent with 24GB claim), and System video memory 8 MB.

The text overlay in photo 0 is not part of the hardware; it is added by the seller. The NVIDIA Control Panel screenshots appear to be from a Windows system, but the resolution is low and pixelated, suggesting possible screen capture or low-quality photo.
